run_densevid_evaluation: run the evaluate.py CLI to evaluate video caption predictions against ground truth references using tIoU thresholds
run_ANETcaptions_evaluate: run the ANETcaptions class evaluate method to compute CIDEr, BLEU, METEOR, ROUGE, and SPICE scores across tIoU thresholds
run_evaluate_detection: run the evaluate_detection method to compute temporal precision and recall for predicted video event timestamps
run_evaluate_tiou: run the evaluate_tiou method to compute caption quality scores at a specific temporal IoU threshold
run_remove_nonascii: run the remove_nonascii function to strip non-ASCII characters from caption text before evaluation
